title: Tamil Flower Classifier
readme_snippet:
# 🌸 Tamil Flower Classifier

A Deep Learning project that classifies Tamil Sangam literature flowers using EfficientNetV2 and GPT-4o Vision. Built to preserve and digitize Tamil botanical heritage by identifying flowers referenced in ancient Sangam poetry.

---

## 📌 Features

- **🧠 EfficientNetV2 Classifier** — Trained on Tamil flower images (ampal, kanthal) with high accuracy
- **🔍 Fake Image Detector** — Fine-tuned model to detect AI-generated or fake flower images
- **🤖 GPT-4o Vision Classifier** — Classifies all 99 Sangam flowers using OpenAI Vision API
- **🌐 Enhanced Classifier** — GPT-4o + SerpAPI real-time search for richer identification
- **📸 Data Augmentation** — OpenCV + Augmentor pipeline to expand training dataset
- **⬇️ Image Downloader** — Automated Bing image download for any flower class

---

---

## ⚙️ Installation

### 1. Clone the repository
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/tamil-flower-classifier.git
cd tamil-flower-classifier
```

### 2. Create virtual environment
```bash
python -m venv venv
venv\Scripts\activate      # Windows
source venv/bin/activate   # Mac/Linux
```

### 3. Install dependencies
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 4. Setup environment variables
```bash
cp .env.example .env
```
Edit `.env`:
```
OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key_here
SERPAPI_KEY=your_serpapi_key_here
```

### 5. Download trained models
See [`models/README_MODELS.md`](models/README_MODELS.md) for download links.

---

## 🚀 Usage

### Train the model
```bash
jupyter notebook train.ipynb
```

### Fine-tune for fake detection
```bash
python finetune.py
```

### Download dataset images
```bash
python download.py
